newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah strengthens in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah strengthens in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah strengthened against the dollar in moderate late trading on Thursday on the back of tighter liquidity, dealers said.
"We had expected the rupiah to remain relatively stable, but it managed to strengthen because of tighter liquidity in the afternoon," one bank dealer said.
The dealer said the tightening of the liquidity could be seen from the sharp rise in the rupiah overnight call money.
The rupiah overnight interbank rate was traded at 25.0/26.0 percent in late trading compared with 10.0/11.0 percent earlier in the day.
Spot rupiah was at 2,430.10/30.50 at 1010 GMT against an opening of 2,431.00/32.00.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were at 2,429.50/29.75 and 2,430.75/31.25, respectively.
Another dealer said liquidity was likely to remain tight on Friday due to weekly tax payment, month-end and half-year book closing factors.
He said the spot rupiah rate was likely to range between 2,429.00 to 2,430.00 on Friday.
He said the central bank's move to raise its fixing rate by one point in the afternoon had largely been expected.
The central bank had kept the fixing rate unchanged from Monday to Wednesday, a move which was considered unusual as the bank usually raised the rate three times a week, he said.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,425/2,617 and its conversion band also by one point to 2,425/2,473 on Thursday.
Overnight swap was last at -0.05/par while tom/next was at 0.80/1.00 points.
One-month swaps were at 14.25/14.75, two at 27.50/28.50, three at 42.50/43.50 and six at 86.25/87.00 points.
